about: T5 · draft's own help, for Ask draft's retrieval (services/assistant/assistant.js). Written from the product as it is (11-11); every href is a real in-app address. Plain words, no promises beyond what ships.

entries.title: Ask me first
entries.text: In Ask me first, draft fills the application and tailors your résumé, then holds it as Ready to approve. Nothing is sent until you approve it.

entries.title: Apply for me
entries.text: Apply for me sends applications on your behalf within the limits you set (how many a day, which jobs). Questions only you can answer, like work authorisation, are asked once and saved.

entries.title: Run now
entries.text: Run now starts the next batch straight away instead of waiting for the schedule. It respects your daily cap and the switches.

entries.title: Tailored résumés
entries.text: For each job, draft rewrites your résumé toward the posting using only what is true in your base résumé, and shows the ATS score before and after. If your résumé already fits, it says so and keeps it as is.

entries.title: Saved answers
entries.text: Saved answers are your answers to common application questions. draft reuses them on every form, and you can change them any time.

entries.title: Atlas
entries.text: Atlas is draft's map of skills, tools and roles, built from real job postings. Each page explains what the thing is and what to learn next.

entries.title: Your skills
entries.text: Your skills lists what you know. A quick check or a link to your work moves a skill from claimed to proved.

entries.title: Interview practice
entries.text: Interview keeps your story bank, your debriefs after each interview and the questions you want to practise.

entries.title: Your data
entries.text: Profile → Privacy and your data lets you download everything draft keeps for you, or delete it all. It also lists every action Ask draft took for you.

entries.title: The job board
entries.text: The board shows postings matched to your profile, best fit first. Use the sentence filter to change role, place or level.
